items.title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Hit With Fraud Lawsuit After $4.5 Billion AI Deal
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks (NasdaqGS:PANW) is facing a material lawsuit from a former executive alleging accounting fraud tied to reseller deals. The complaint claims the cybersecurity group inflated revenue through questionable reseller arrangements and then wrongfully terminated the executive. The filing surfaced shortly after Palo Alto Networks announced a US$4.5b AI focused acquisition, which has intensified attention on its reporting practices. items.title: Own Palo Alto Stock? Watch Its Deferred Revenue
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks closed at $356.14 on Wednesday, Nov 25, up 0.9%. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF fell 0.3% the same day. On Nov 18, after the market closed, the company reported results. It also said it plans to buy Applied Compute for $4.5 billion, paid in stock. The stock jumped 6.4% the next day. This article looks past the price, at the company's own cash and contracts.
